title: Bi Yao's sacrifice
summary: Learning that Pu Zhi massacred Grass Temple Village, Zhang Xiaofan breaks down. Pu Hong says Pu Zhi was possessed by the Sinister Bead and that Xiaofan is not to blame, but Xiaofan rages that he kept Pu Zhi's secret at the risk of his life and got nothing for it, and attacks. Dao Xuan stops him with 'Seven Stars Return', Bi Yao tries to take him away, and the Ghost King arrives to protect his daughter as the Demon Sect attacks again. Fa Xiang strikes Xiaofan with the Samsara Bead and wounds his heart, and Xiaofan slips into a killing rage until Bi Yao calls him back. Saying Xiaofan has fallen, Dao Xuan brings down the Zhu Xian Sword on him. Bi Yao chants a blood spell, offers herself, and takes the blow in his place. Afterwards Qing Long begs Mr. Ghost to save her: Mr. Ghost explains that the Lovestruck Spell costs the caster any rebirth, that the Hehuan Bell caught her soul and kept her body whole, and that the only hope is a legendary revival spell from the Southern Border. Holding her, Xiaofan tells Bi Yao it was her he saw in the Full Moon Ancient Well. A closing scene jumps ten years ahead.

Southern Border (a revival spell said to exist there)
